guitar.modelsText: Lowden/Sheeran signature model (Little Lula) and Martin LX1E (Little Martin)
models: Sheeran signature model (Little Lula) and Martin LX1E (Little Martin)
guitar.evidence: Ed Sheeran is closely identified with his small Martin LX1E ('Little Martin') travel guitar and later his Sheeran by Lowden signature models; widely documented.

tone.target: bright pop-rock acoustic-like electric strum with light crunch
tone.profile: bright pop-rock acoustic-like electric strum with light crunch
tone.summary: A bright, compressed signal chain using a light boost and US Deluxe/Silver Twin emulation for an acoustic-pop feel, finished with Chorus and Room reverb for polish.
corrections: lean more acoustic-strum than clean pop

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight signal clarity.
